PTJ in Market Wizards, when asked why he trains a group of apprentice traders

"When I was twenty-one years old, a guy took me under his wing and it was the greatest thing that ever happened to me. I felt an obligation to do the same thing for other people."

felt this deep💯💯

lets fucking go

so if you're putting out 0, and taking in much, ur trajectory is all fucked up.

read "as a man thinketh" by james allen, he has the right mindset for what u want uploaded to ur operating system in the AM

and then

"Never play cards with a man called Doc. Never eat at a place called Mom’s. Never sleep with a woman whose troubles are worse than your own."
